name: nymeria-mobile
description: NYMERIA web game and isolated Capacitor mobile packaging

scripts.android:debug: npm run sync:mobile && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.ios:check: npm run sync:mobile && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
